title: S044 8.2.1.3 FSM and Optional Session Attributes
parent_path: S044 8.2.1.3 FSM and Optional Session Attributes

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: DelayOpenTimer has a group of attributes: flag indicating support (DelayOpen), Time set in Timer (DelayOpenTime), and Timer (DelayOpenTimer).
statements.guard_semantics: If DelayOpen cannot be set to TRUE, the timer and events supporting DelayOpen do not have to be supported.

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: DelayOpenTimer group attribute: Time set in Timer (DelayOpenTime).
statements.guard_semantics: Required only when DelayOpen flag can be set to TRUE.

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: DelayOpenTimer group attribute: the timer itself (DelayOpenTimer).
statements.guard_semantics: Required only when DelayOpen flag can be set to TRUE.

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: IdleHoldTimer has a group of attributes: flag indicating support (DampPeerOscillations), Time set in Timer (IdleHoldTime), and Timer (IdleHoldTimer).
statements.guard_semantics: If DampPeerOscillations cannot be set to TRUE, the timer and events supporting IdleHoldTimer do not have to be supported.

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: IdleHoldTimer group attribute: Time set in Timer (IdleHoldTime).
statements.guard_semantics: Required only when DampPeerOscillations flag can be set to TRUE.

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: IdleHoldTimer group attribute: the timer itself (IdleHoldTimer).
statements.guard_semantics: Required only when DampPeerOscillations flag can be set to TRUE.

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: If the optional session attribute can be set to TRUE on the system, the corresponding BGP FSM actions must be supported. For example, if AutoStart and PassiveTcpEstablishment can be set, then Events 3, 4 and 5 must be supported.
statements.guard_semantics: session_attributes.AutoStart = TRUE | session_attributes.PassiveTcpEstablishment = TRUE => Events 3, 4, 5 must be supported

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: If an Optional Session attribute cannot be set to TRUE, the events supporting that set of options do not have to be supported.
